# dr_mp3

MP3 decoding for Naru Studio's shared editor/player audio library.

- Upstream: https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs
- File: https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs/blob/35b5c392cc15456736c440a68dbe073178bbffe0/dr_mp3.h
- Commit: `35b5c392cc15456736c440a68dbe073178bbffe0` (also in REVISION.txt).
- SHA-256: `f5c8020eeebb79877184432efdd2651f24869f5bb8f379d45450fd0aed1ee915`
- License: upstream offers public domain or MIT-0. Naru uses the MIT-0 option. Full upstream license statements, including minimp3 attribution, remain unchanged at the end of dr_mp3.h.
- No network or external package installation is needed during a build.
